gcp._note: origin='unknown' and state='unknown' are the CORRECT normalization result per contracts/normalization/route.py's own docstring -- GCP's Route API returns no origin/state field at all, only configuration (destination, priority, next hop). priority=1000 is populated because that is GCP's own genuine strength here (an explicit tie-break AWS/Azure don't have). The canonical Route model has no network_urn field (routes reference a network only indirectly via RouteTable elsewhere, and GCP has no RouteTable) so the owning network is preserved only here in extensions.gcp.network_self_link -- see NOTES.md.
